description: Vendors based in a designated high-risk jurisdiction, or spend at or above the enhanced due-diligence threshold, require completed vendor screening plus enhanced due-diligence sign-off (e.g. local counsel review) before spend is incurred.

policy_references.citation: CFATF (Caribbean Financial Action Task Force) high-risk and monitored jurisdictions guidance
policy_references.notes: Basis for treating certain jurisdictions as requiring enhanced due diligence. high_risk_country_codes in this control is an internal working list, not a verbatim copy of any single published list, so it remains an internal-policy value.

policy_references.citation: Barbados Public Procurement Act, 2021 (Act No. 30 of 2021)
policy_references.authority: Office of the Chief Procurement Officer, Barbados
policy_references.notes: Applies the CARICOM Protocol on Procurement to cross-border/international vendor engagements.

policy_references.citation: Internal High-Risk Jurisdiction and Enhanced Due-Diligence Standard
policy_references.notes: Sets high_risk_country_codes and enhanced_dd_required_above_amount. No single verified numeric or list-based regulatory floor was found to check these against.
